mapper.select:
SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TB_MHSMONITORINFO A JOIN LETTNAUTHORGROUPINFO B ON A.MHS_BRANDCD = B.GROUP_ID JOIN TB_CENTERINFO C ON A.MHS_CENTERCD = C.CENTER_ID JOIN LETTNAUTHORGROUPINFO D ON C.ROLE_CODE = D.GROUP_ID WHERE A.MHS_MONITORSTATUS != 'N'
AND A.MHS_CENTERCD = #{mhsCentercd}
AND A.MHS_MONITORNM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND A.MHS_MONITORCD LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND A.MHS_IPADDR LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND A.MHS_MACADDR LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT A.MHS_MONITORCD AS mhsMonitorcd, A.MHS_MONITORNM AS mhsMonitornm, A.MHS_BRANDCD AS mhsBrandcd, A.MHS_CENTERCD AS mhsCentercd, A.MHS_MVIEWTYPE AS mhsMviewtype, A.MHS_IPADDR AS mhsIpaddr, A.MHS_MACADDR AS mhsMacaddr, A.MHS_MREGID AS mhsMregid, A.MHS_MREGDATE AS mhsMregdate, A.MHS_MUPDATEID AS mhsMupdateid, A.MHS_MUPDATEDATE AS mhsMupdatedate, A.MHS_LASTCONN AS mhsLastconn, A.MHS_REMARK AS mhsRemark, A.MHS_MONITORSTATUS AS mhsMonitorstatus, B.GROUP_NM AS "mhsBrandnm", C.CENTER_NM AS "mhsCenternm" FROM TB_MHSMONITORINFO A JOIN LETTNAUTHORGROUPINFO B ON A.MHS_BRANDCD = B.GROUP_ID JOIN TB_CENTERINFO C ON A.MHS_CENTERCD = C.CENTER_ID WHERE A.MHS_MONITORCD = #{mhsMonitorcd}
SELECT MHS_MONITORNM AS mhsMonitornm, MHS_MONITORCD AS mhsMonitorcd FROM TB_MHSMONITORINFO WHERE MHS_CENTERCD = #{mhsCentercd} ORDER BY MHS_MONITORNM ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MHSMONITORINFO ( MHS_MONITORCD, MHS_MONITORNM, MHS_BRANDCD, MHS_CENTERCD, MHS_MVIEWTYPE, MHS_MREGID, MHS_MREGDATE, MHS_MUPDATEID, MHS_MUPDATEDATE, MHS_REMARK, MHS_MONITORSTATUS ) VALUES ( #{mhsMonitorcd}, #{mhsMonitornm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mhsBrandcd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mhsCentercd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mhsMviewtype,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mhsMregid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{mhsMregid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{mhsRemark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y' )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MHSMONITORINFO SET MHS_LASTCONN = NOW(), MHS_MONITORSTATUS = 'Y' WHERE MHS_MONITORCD = #{mhsMonitorcd}
